tokens.name: orange-600
tokens.usage: Darker accent (pressed CTA, shadow side of a reflection). White text on it is 3.9:1, so large text only.

tokens.name: orange-500
tokens.usage: Primary accent. CTAs and light reflections only: never body text, never a large fill. Text on it is ink-900 (5.7:1); white on it is 3.1:1 and fails at body size.

tokens.name: orange-400
tokens.usage: Bright core of an orange reflection in a render.

tokens.name: orange-300
tokens.usage: Soft warm glow / rim light in renders.

tokens.name: orange-100
tokens.usage: Falloff of a warm reflection on the canvas. Not a card background.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Lightest paper: canvas highlights.

tokens.name: paper-200
tokens.usage: The canvas. Default background of every slide.

tokens.name: paper-300
tokens.usage: Canvas shadow side; floor shadow under a render.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Dark type on bare canvas (8.3:1 on paper-200): slide chrome (wordmark, slide number) when it sits over canvas, not render.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Rare dark type only (15:1 on paper-200): a cover headline over a light render, the label on an orange CTA.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: slide background.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Semantic alias: the one accent. Used sparingly.

tokens.name: glass-surface
tokens.usage: Frosted glass card fill, always with glass-blur and radius-glass. Translucent, so text contrast depends on the render BEHIND the card (README > Contrast).

tokens.name: on-glass
tokens.usage: Primary text on glass: titles, cover headline. Passes when the render behind the card is ~#7a7976 or darker (4.4:1 there; 6.9:1 over ink-700).

tokens.name: on-glass-eyebrow
tokens.usage: Eyebrow labels and number words (ONE, TWO). Uppercase, tracked; needs ink-700 or darker behind the card (4.4:1).

tokens.name: on-glass-muted
tokens.usage: Body text on glass. FLAG: reaches 4.5:1 only when the render behind the card is near ink-900 (5.1:1). Over ink-700 it is 3.8:1; over bare canvas 1.5:1.

tokens.name: on-glass-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: inactive carousel dots, hairlines. Never words (3.2:1 at best).

styles.name: cover-headline
styles.sample: USE AI LIKE A CREATIVE DIRECTOR
styles.usage: Cover only. UPPERCASE, 110-130px (120 default), 2-4 lines, bottom-left.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.sample: Feed it your best post, not a blank prompt
styles.usage: Content-slide title on glass. Sentence case, 56-64px (60 default), up to 3 lines.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Paste one post that worked. Ask the AI why it worked, then ask for five more in the same shape.
styles.usage: Body on glass in on-glass-muted. 30-34px (32 default), max 3 lines. Line height 1.35 is assumed (not in the spec).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Cover eyebrow and the number word (ONE, TWO) on cards. UPPERCASE, 28-30px, on-glass-eyebrow (70% white).

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Top-left of every slide (MAYANK KONTEY), and MK inside the glass card. Size, weight and tracking are assumed: the spec names the wordmark but not its style.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Small gaps: dot spacing, icon-to-label. Assumed.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to headline, number word to title, title to body. Assumed.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Headline block to swipe cue; CTA side padding. Assumed.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Glass card inner padding. Assumed.

tokens.name: safe-margin
tokens.usage: From the spec: safe margin on all four edges of a 1080 x 1350 slide. Nothing readable outside it.

tokens.name: radius-glass
tokens.usage: From the spec: glass card corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Carousel dots, swipe arrow, CTA pill. Assumed.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: From the spec: backdrop-filter blur on every glass card.

frame.note: The slide frame. Author every slide at this size.

tokens.name: frame-width
tokens.usage: Instagram portrait carousel width.

tokens.name: frame-height
tokens.usage: Instagram portrait carousel height (4:5).
